rtl_micro_fix.scope: ONE minimal cycle-neutral change in upstream/ph1p100-pcie-ep-fpga/rtl/ep_side/codec/a1_deflate_core.v only
change: Add a registered copy of the existing stage-1 predicate s1_ok: declare 'reg s1_ok_r;' next to s1_vld_r, and register it in the stage-1 block: 's1_ok_r <= s1_ok;' (unconditional, aligned with s1_vld_r <= s1_en).
In rng2 (line 504), replace '(pos < lim2)' with 's1_ok_r': wire rng2 = (hp_r < pos) && (hdist2 <= MAX_DIST) && s1_ok_r;
Keep s1_ok itself and all other consumers (htab_we etc.) unchanged; keep (hp_r < pos) and (hdist2 <= MAX_DIST) unchanged.
rtl_micro_fix.rationale: At the cycle the stage-1 result is consumed, pos equals the stage-1 cycle's s1_pos_r and lim2 is block-constant, so (pos < lim2) equals the previous cycle's s1_ok = (s1_pos_r < lim2); this equivalence is already documented in the RTL comment (lines 495-502). Registering s1_ok removes the 13-bit comparator from the hit2 -> bm_raddr_a/b mux -> ERAM address and hit2 -> CE cones without adding a pipeline cycle.

rtl_micro_fix.forbidden: No second fix, no changes to (hp_r < pos) / hdist2 logic, no state machine changes, no cycle addition, no frame/SDC edits.
